69.name: GNSS Status
69.description: 0 - GNSS OFF 1 - GNSS ON with fix 2 - GNSS ON without fix 3 - GNSS sleep

155.name: Manual Geofence ID
155.description: Value = (<geofence_id> - 1); eg. geofence #10 generates AVL ID 155 with value 9

157.name: Manual Geofence Speeding event
157.description: 0 - Speeding stop event; 1 - Speeding start event

175.name: Auto geofence
175.description: 0 – Target left zone 1 – Target enetered zone

181.name: GNSS PDOP
181.description: GNSS position dilution of precision. Normal PDOP is below 3 – the lower the number, the more accurate reported location is.

182.name: GNSS HDOP
182.description: GNSS horizontal dilution of precision. Normal HDOP is below 2 – the lower the number, the more accurate reported location is.

199.name: Trip Odometer
199.description: Trip distance value calculated by GNSS

200.name: Sleep Mode
200.description: 0 – Normal Mode(Device is not in sleep mode) 1 – Not used 2 – Not used 3 – Online Deep Sleep 4 – Deep Sleep 5 – Power Off Sleep

206.name: GSM Area Code
206.description: Location Area code (LAC), it depends on GSM operator. It provides unique number which assigned to a set of base GSM stations

237.name: Network Type
237.description: 0 - 3G 1 - GSM 2 - 4G 3 - LTE CAT M1 4 - LTE CAT NB1 99 - Unknown

242.name: Fall down detection
242.description: 0 - Fall down Detection deactivated 1 - Fall down activated

250.name: Trip
250.description: 0 – trip stop 1 – trip start 2 – Business Status 3 – Private Status 4-9 – Custom Statuses

253.name: Eco driving type
253.description: 1 – harsh acceleration 2 – harsh braking 3 – harsh cornering

254.name: Eco driving value
254.description: Depending on Eco driving type: if harsh acceleration or braking – g*100 (value 123 -> 1.23g). If Eco driving source is „GPS“ – harsh cornering value is rad/s*100. If source is „Accelerometer“ – g*100.

255.name: Over Speeding
255.description: At over speeding start km/h, at over speeding end km/h

358.name: Custom scenario 1
358.description: 0 – Custom Scenario Inactive 1 – Custom Scenario Activated

359.name: Custom scenario 2
359.description: 0 – Custom Scenario Inactive 1 – Custom Scenario Activated

360.name: Custom scenario 3
360.description: 0 – Custom Scenario Inactive 1 – Custom Scenario Activated

383.name: Accelerometer calibration status
383.description: Shows calibration status: 0- No calibration, 1- Calibrated, 2- Not configured, 3- Fully calibrated

391.name: Private/Business
391.description: 0 - Private mode OFF (Business mode ON); 1 - Private mode ON (Business mode OFF)

392.name: Button Click
392.description: Button ID (X) and Action (Y) Value 0x XY X - button ID: 1 - power button Y - action: 1 - 1 click 2 - 2 clicks 3 - long click

449.name: Ignition On Counter
449.description: Counter that represents how much seconds the device spent with ignition in ON state

641.name: ICCID
641.description: Value of SIM ICCID (Integrated circuit card identification number)

1148.name: Connectivity quality
1148.description: Provides detailed signal quality information in LTE, eMTC (CAT-Mx) and NB-IoT modes: RSSI (byte 0): 0 - 255 in dBm (negative values) RSRP (byte 1): 0 - 255 in dBm (negative values) SINR (byte 2): 0 - 250 which translates to -20dB to +30dB (1/5th of dB) RSRQ (byte 3): 0 - 255 in dB (negative values)

1429.name: Crash average vector
1429.description: Stores the average vector calculated during the crash: 2B - X axis, 2B - Y axis, 2B - Z axis, 2B - magnitude in mG.

1430.name: Crash direction
1430.description: Stores the indication if the accelerometer is calibrated. Also, indicates the direction of the crash. 1 bit (highest bit) indicates calibration status, rest of the bits indicates crash direction.

1432.name: Crash max vector
1432.description: Stores the max vector calculated during the crash: 2B - X axis, 2B - Y axis, 2B - Z axis, 2B - magnitude in mG.

1437.name: Side Vector Delta
1437.description: Represents the angle difference between the calculated accelerometer calibration and the device's actual mounting position

1440.name: Accel Calibration Quality
1440.description: Calibration quality index. A value of 0 indicates the worst quality; 100 indicates perfect calibration.

13361.name: Incoming call detection
